On the neutral tangent cap first derivatives vanish and threshold and diagonal velocities cancel. The translation term is square-zero and its cross traces with E vanish, so tr(B²)=tr(E²). If d=1 the gauge critical tangent has no unit vector and the same contradiction applies.
